property_summary: For any caller, the owner can only be changed by the current owner; the buggy version allows any caller to change the owner, so the invariant that owner remains unchanged after a non-owner call holds for the reference but fails for the mutant.

A non-owner caller must not be able to change the owner; the mutant allows any caller to change it, so a non-owner-set attempt leaves owner equal to the original owner in the reference but changes it in the mutant.
After any call to setOwner, the owner must remain unchanged from its pre-call value; the mutant allows a caller to change owner without restriction, violating this conservation.
After any call to setOwner(...), the owner must remain unchanged if the caller is not the current owner; the buggy version allows anyone to change the owner.
